description.en: A cursor-following glass lens that refracts your live HTML and zooms in on targets like a crystal ball.
description.zh: 玻璃透镜跟随光标，折射实时 HTML，并像水晶球一样放大目标。

discovery.caveat: 涉及实时 HTML 捕获；玻璃文件管理卡片应选择 glass-folder。

notice.en: Reference entry. This AI catalog does not redistribute component source. Install directly from the author's registry under its license; the @canvas-ui namespace belongs to the upstream author.
notice.zh: 来源收藏条目。本 AI 目录不重新分发组件源码；如需使用，请遵守作者许可并直接从作者的注册表安装。@canvas-ui 属于上游作者。

description.en: Lens size (radius, or half height for rectangles) in CSS pixels.
description.zh: 镜片尺寸，单位为 CSS 像素；圆形为半径，矩形为半高。

description.en: Width to height ratio of the rectangle shape (1 to 3).
description.zh: 矩形形状的宽高比（1 至 3）。

description.en: Corner radius for square and rectangle shapes in CSS pixels.
description.zh: 正方形及矩形的圆角半径，单位为 CSS 像素。

description.en: Index of refraction of the glass (1 to 2). Higher bends light more strongly at the rim.
description.zh: 玻璃折射率（1 至 2），值越高边缘对光线的弯折越强。

description.en: Fraction of the lens that stays optically flat before the rim starts bending (0 to 1).
description.zh: 镜片边缘开始弯折前保持光学平坦的比例（0 至 1）。

description.en: How sharply the rim curves away (1 to 10).
description.zh: 镜片边缘弯曲的锐度（1 至 10）。

description.en: Optical depth in CSS pixels: how far the glass floats above the page, which scales the refraction displacement.
description.zh: 光学深度，单位为 CSS 像素：玻璃悬浮于页面上方的距离，决定折射位移的大小。

description.en: Chromatic aberration strength at the rim (0 to 3). 0 disables the spectral split.
description.zh: 边缘色差强度（0 至 3），0 关闭光谱分离。

description.en: Frosted blur of the glass face (0 to 4). 0 keeps the glass optically clear.
description.zh: 玻璃表面的磨砂模糊程度（0 至 4），0 保持光学清晰。

description.en: Strength of the fresnel reflection on the rim (0 to 2). 0 disables it.
description.zh: 边缘菲涅耳反射的强度（0 至 2），0 关闭。

description.en: Specular rim highlight (0 to 2) that keeps the lens visible over plain backgrounds. 0 disables it.
description.zh: 镜面边缘高光（0 至 2），使镜片在纯色背景上仍可见；0 关闭。

description.en: Magnification while hovering a target element (1 to 3), like a crystal ball.
description.zh: 悬停目标元素时的放大倍数（1 至 3），类似水晶球。

description.en: CSS selector for the elements that trigger the crystal ball zoom on hover.
description.zh: 触发悬停水晶球放大的元素 CSS 选择器。

description.en: How quickly the lens follows the cursor (0 to 1). 1 snaps to it.
description.zh: 镜片跟随光标的速度（0 至 1），1 表示紧贴。

description.en: Classes applied to the wrapper element.
description.zh: 应用到包装元素的 CSS 类。

dependencies.frameworkNote: Solid uses solid-js; Preact uses preact. Other framework dependencies follow the target project.

install.behavior: Commands are metadata only. This catalog and CLI never execute installation.

browserNotes: WebGPU builds need a browser with WebGPU; verify the current browser support before choosing a renderer.
HTML-in-Canvas is experimental. Check the component's current upstream browser/fallback documentation. Do not assume DOM capture works in every browser.
